title: Why We Should Stop Using JavaScript According to Douglas Crockford (Inventor of JSON)
summary: A short video built around Douglas Crockford, creator of JSON, saying JavaScript is a flawed language and that developers should eventually move on from it. It is a brief commentary clip with little technical detail.
why: HN users cite it to show that even Crockford, once a JavaScript evangelist, has soured on the language, though some find it thin on substance.

quote.text: I don't think crockford likes JS anymore
